name: West Virginia
overview: West Virginia provides separate refundable senior, excess-property-tax and disabled-veteran credits, with rules preventing duplicate relief.

programs.name: Senior Citizens Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: Homestead Exemption participant: 65 or older, or permanently and totally disabled.
programs.incomeDefinition: SCTC-A household income under program rules.
programs.incomeLimits: 150% federal poverty guidelines: $23,475 for one person in 2025, plus $8,250 for each additional person.
programs.maximumBenefit: Eligible taxes on the next $20,000 taxable assessed value above the homestead exemption.
programs.formulaSummary: Refunds qualifying Class II tax paid on that assessed-value slice.
programs.application: Use original SCTC-A from Tax Division, separately for eligible nonfilers or with IT-140.
eligibilityNotes: Must owe and pay qualifying homestead tax.
interactions: Reduces HEPTC; cannot combine with Disabled Veteran Property Tax Credit.

programs.name: Homestead Excess Property Tax Credit
programs.incomeDefinition: Gross household income including Social Security for burden calculation; eligibility has separate low-income rules.
programs.incomeLimits: Program low-income test based on 300% federal poverty guidelines.
programs.formulaSummary: Eligible owner-occupied real-property taxes, after senior credit, exceeding 4% of gross household income, capped at $1,000.
programs.application: File HEPTC-1 with IT-140 and property-tax receipt.
eligibilityNotes: Homestead Exemption participation is not required.
Income-year treatment must be checked against 2025 form, not generic webpage.
interactions: Calculate senior credit first; subtract it.
Cannot combine with Disabled Veteran Property Tax Credit.

programs.name: Disabled Veteran Real Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: Honorably discharged veteran with qualifying service-connected disability; qualifying unremarried surviving spouse.
programs.maximumBenefit: Eligible homestead real-property taxes timely paid during the income-tax year.
programs.formulaSummary: Refundable credit for qualifying homestead taxes, limited by statutory veteran criteria and timely payment.
programs.application: File DV-1 with property-tax receipts and VA disability-rating letter.
eligibilityNotes: At least 90% totally and permanently disabled due solely to service-connected disabilities under cited guidance.
interactions: Alternative to Senior Citizens Tax Credit and HEPTC.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.ageRule: 65 or older or permanently and totally disabled.
programs.formulaSummary: Assessed-value exemption administered by county assessor; it precedes senior-credit calculations.

The three credits are not independent amounts that may simply be added.
